name: Howard Wilyman
about: Hi! I'm Howard, a student at Xiamen University Malaysia. I like turning ideas into interactive experiences, like this AR card. Tap the other nodes to see what I do and how to reach me.

portfolio.title: AquaStrike
portfolio.caption: A 1v1 online water-gun shooter in a giant inflatable water park, with water balloons and three squad fighters. Solo, Unity and C#, 2026.

portfolio.title: We Were Mummies
portfolio.caption: A 2-player online co-op escape from an Egyptian tomb where each player is missing a sense. Named Best Game. Unity and Photon, 2026.

portfolio.title: Sea Vagabond
portfolio.caption: A third-person action-adventure through jungles, storms and lava caves. I designed Level 1. Award winner at EGDAD-XMUM 2025, team of 6.

portfolio.title: MR Detective
portfolio.caption: My final year project: two players solve one crime scene together in co-located mixed reality on Meta Quest 3. Unity, 2026.
